0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000010_EMETSELCH
0.description: And lo, vile beasts did rise...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000020_EMETSELCH
1.description: Leaving naught in their wake but blood and ash.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000030_EMETSELCH
2.description: Sun scorches earth and boils seas...

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000040_EMETSELCH
3.description: And our sins ascend unto the heavens─

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000050_EMETSELCH
4.description: Three dooms to unmake all we were.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000060_ALISAIE
5.description: The sky burns. The Final Days...are truly upon us.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000070_AWAHEEN
6.description: ...My friends. I trust you have heard the news.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: We have. What can you tell us of the situation, Your Excellency?

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000090_AWAHEEN
8.description: Last night, the isle was rocked by tremors, and the earth itself cried out.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000100_AWAHEEN
9.description: Aloft, the heavens began to burn. From all about, unholy beasts─the likes of which we had never seen─came forth in fury and rage.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000110_AWAHEEN
10.description: ...No. To say they “came forth” would be...inexact.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000120_AWAHEEN
11.description: The people of Radz-at-Han themselves transformed into these baleful fiends.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000130_AWAHEEN
12.description: Though the phenomenon was observed throughout our lands, the first creature─the largest and most dreadful of the lot─wrought havoc upon us here, in our fair city.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000140_AWAHEEN
13.description: Though they bear superficial resemblance to divinities of legend, they are ungodly abominations. The people decry them as “blasphemies.”

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000150_AWAHEEN
14.description: The large one's rampage has since taken it to the northern reaches of the island. I mean to dispatch our Radiant Host in an attempt to quell the threat.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000170_AWAHEEN
16.description: Vrtra, too, makes for the north of his own accord. And yet...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000180_AWAHEEN
17.description: He knows the blasphemy and its minions were but yesterday his beloved people.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000190_AWAHEEN
18.description: I pray his boundless compassion and mercy does not deter him from taking unenviable but necessary action.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000200_ALPHINAUD
19.description: ...Understood. I ask that you allow us to aid you in quelling this threat.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000210_AWAHEEN
20.description: You would risk your lives to help us yet again? I have no words to express my gratitude.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000220_AWAHEEN
21.description: Our regiments approach the north from several directions, with a number of units set to depart from the docks of Yedlihmad.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000230_AWAHEEN
22.description: They will make landfall in an area of dense jungle, where one can expect to encounter dangers even beyond the fell beasts we hunt.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000240_AWAHEEN
23.description: I leave you to your preparation. You will find me at the docks when you are ready to depart.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000250_ALISAIE
24.description: We're as prepared as we'll ever be. Let's go.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000310_YSHTOLA
30.description: The beast was there...and now it is no more, yes?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000320_THANCRED
31.description: Indeed, we saw it plain. But...you didn't, did you?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000330_YSHTOLA
32.description: I saw nothing. Not the blasphemy that perished here, nor the other men-turned-beasts. And because of this, I now see all too well...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000340_YSHTOLA
33.description: There is no aether. Where the creatures should be, I saw naught but emptiness...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000360_YSHTOLA
35.description: Recall the words of the watcher. 'Twas a stagnancy of aether─a cessation of flow leading to decay and absence─that led the ancients to conclude their star was dying...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000370_YSHTOLA
36.description: This is the same phenomenon. The instant these people are seized by the transformation, their aether begins to...rot and crumble away like dried mud...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000380_YSHTOLA
37.description: Until, from their corporeal forms to their very souls, naught remains...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000390_ALISAIE
38.description: But the beast spoke with its dying breath! Surely, at least a sliver of the man it was endured!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000400_YSHTOLA
39.description: ...Mayhap so. But even if the process was incomplete, 'twas little more than a faint residue.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000410_ALISAIE
40.description: Gods be good... You're saying they cannot be saved?

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000420_YSHTOLA
41.description: Not by any means known to me.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000430_YSHTOLA
42.description: ...Or by any means at all, like as not. For there is naught left to save.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000440_GRAHATIA
43.description: They return not even to the aetherial sea...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000450_VRITRA
44.description: The beasts rage on, their hunger insatiable...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000460_VRITRA
45.description: Even deprived of their master, they perpetuate his legacy of hate.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000470_VRITRA
46.description: Once proud sons and daughters of Thavnair, all of them...and now I spill their blood!

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000480_AWAHEEN
47.description: Vrtra! My friends! I am heartened to see you safe.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000490_ESTINIEN
48.description: You put your secret at risk.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000500_AWAHEEN
49.description: Those closest to me already know the truth─a truth I must now share with one and all.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000510_AWAHEEN
50.description: ...Vrtra. Calamity has come to Radz-at-Han. Our fair nation is rent by screams of pain and despair.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000520_AWAHEEN
51.description: More than ever, we require a strong leader to shepherd us through the storm. Reveal your true self to our people, Vrtra, and guide us to salvation!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000530_VRITRA
52.description: What madness is this, Ahewann? Thou dost forget thyself.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000540_VRITRA
53.description: Were we to reveal our duplicity, it would do naught but foster confusion and chaos.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000550_VRITRA
54.description: Nay, I shall remain the satrap's loyal ally, and do battle with the beasts. Easing hearts and leading the people to safety is thy task, and thine alone.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000560_VRITRA
55.description: I ask that you remain at Ahewann's side, and render unto him what aid you may.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000570_VRITRA
56.description: I know not what lies ahead, but without you, Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han will not survive.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000590_ESTINIEN
58.description: I am as at home fighting in the air as I am on land. Take me with you.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000600_VRITRA
59.description: Were my words unclear? I require no assistance. Thy place is at Ahewann's side.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000620_THANCRED
61.description: It's the last thing you ever wanted─a linkpearl.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000630_THANCRED
62.description: We'd gain much from knowing your elevated perspective. And it'll keep you from getting lonely─which I know you loathe.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000650_ESTINIEN
64.description: You heard the man. Seems I'm coming with you after all.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000660_VRITRA
65.description: Then I pray thy grip is iron. Be it on thy head if thou dost chance to fall.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000680_AWAHEEN
67.description: I fear it is as Vrtra says: we will not survive this on our own. While I am loath to impose upon you again...

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000690_ALPHINAUD
68.description: I would insist if you did not. 'Tis the very reason we have come.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000700_AWAHEEN
69.description: Then once more I find myself without words to thank you properly. Let us return to the capital and plan our next course of action.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000710_YSHTOLA
70.description: There you are. You've spoken with the survivors?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000720_GRAHATIA
71.description: Indeed. We thought to share what we have gleaned, that we might together gain a greater understanding of present circumstances.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000730_ALPHINAUD
72.description: Fortuitous timing. Alisaie and I completed our own investigations not long ago.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000740_YSHTOLA
73.description: Then we should take a moment to compare notes. Shall we begin with the two of you?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000750_ALPHINAUD
74.description: ...So the merchant Khalzahl was gravely concerned about his business in the days preceding his untimely end.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000760_ALISAIE
75.description: The tales we heard were much the same. The first victims to be changed into blasphemies were all overcome with anguish of one manner or another.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000770_ALISAIE
76.description: Then those who saw their loved ones stolen before their eyes succumbed to a similar panic, setting in motion a chain of transformations.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000780_ALPHINAUD
77.description: Fear, unease, despair...these negative feelings serve as a catalyst.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000790_YSHTOLA
78.description: If so, then it is not unlike the calamity that befell the ancients.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000800_YSHTOLA
79.description: With their creation magicks they unwittingly gave form to untold horrors.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000810_YSHTOLA
80.description: Had they simply lost control, surely it would have manifested in many forms─not all of them monstrous.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000820_YSHTOLA
81.description: Yet somehow this phenomenon is triggered solely by the darkness in their hearts. A common thread with what we now witness.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000830_ALPHINAUD
82.description: ...Common, but not identical. While the beasts the ancients faced were forged with magic alone, those of today are born of sentient beings.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000840_ALPHINAUD
83.description: Why remains to be seen, but there is one fundamental difference between us and our predecessors: our souls are sundered, whereas theirs were not.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000850_ALPHINAUD
84.description: Perhaps that single variable makes all the difference.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000860_GRAHATIA
85.description: If I may...there was another detail that troubled me.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000870_GRAHATIA
86.description: We have it on good authority that Khalzahl's transformation took place before the skies began to burn.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000880_ALISAIE
87.description: What!? If that's true, then the situation's more dire than we realized.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000890_ALISAIE
88.description: It means even if there's no ominous sign presaging the Final Days, anyone─anywhere─has the potential to become a beast.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000900_ALISAIE
89.description: Even in lands we thought safe. Even as we speak...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000940_AWAHEEN
93.description: My countrymen. I am relieved and heartened to see you strong and safe.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000950_AWAHEEN
94.description: While the danger has not yet passed─far from it─allow me to assure you that the beasts that raged within the city walls have been exterminated to the last.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000960_AWAHEEN
95.description: Outside this sanctuary, the brave men and women of the Radiant Host and our dragon ally continue to battle our unholy foes.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000970_AWAHEEN
96.description: I pray these tidings put your minds at ease, and help you calm your hearts. Have faith that we shall soon conquer this terrible trial.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000980_HANNISHOLDWOMANA
97.description: Your Excellency...is there any word from Palaka's Stand?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_000990_HANNISHOLDWOMANA
98.description: My grandson was bound for there yesterday, and I-I worry for his life...

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001000_AWAHEEN
99.description: We are still awaiting a report. But I promise you, as soon as I have aught to share...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001030_MATSYA
102.description: I...I'm Matsya of Akyaali. A humble fisherman.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001040_THANCRED
103.description: Ah, I remember you from our first visit.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001070_MATSYA
106.description: When the skies turned red, I set off for Palaka's Stand, fearing for the safety of a friend.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001080_MATSYA
107.description: But as I drew near the village, I saw dreadful beasts all about.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001100_HANNISHOLDWOMANA
109.description: Your Excellency! Save my grandson! I beg of you!

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001110_AWAHEEN
110.description: We will spare no effort to save all we can. But you must remain calm─

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001120_HANNISHOLDWOMANA
111.description: Calm!? You tell me to be calm!? You saw those beasts! They tore our bravest warriors limb from limb!

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001130_HANNISHOLDWOMANA
112.description: What if we are too late? If they catch him─sink their fangs into him...

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001180_THANCRED
117.description: ...Damn it. We've got to kill them before it spreads!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001190_YSHTOLA
118.description: We'll handle this. See the townspeople to safety!

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001200_HANNISHMANA
119.description: Run! As fast as you can!

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001250_AWAHEEN
127.description: Vrtra... Our people... You must save them!

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001270_GRAHATIA
129.description: Enough! You must run, for their sake and your own!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001280_GRAHATIA
131.description: Yes. You will survive. You must.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001310_GRAHATIA
134.description: Fear not, for we will defeat these abominations!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001320_GRAHATIA
135.description: Brave men and women of the Radiant Host! Lend Y'shtola and Thancred your aid! Let not a single beast escape!

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001330_GRAHATIA
136.description: The rest of you, flee this place! Carry the wounded if you must! Head indoors, or underground!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001340_GRAHATIA
137.description: Above all, stay calm. No beasts will follow you─we will see to that.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001350_THANCRED
138.description: Alphinaud! Alisaie! Leave the city to us, and make for Palaka's Stand at once!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001360_THANCRED
139.description: Matsya, show my friends to the village. I promise you─they're more capable than the Host's finest.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001390_GRAHATIA
142.description: We will save these people─as many as we can!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001400_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
143.description: Meanwhile, in the skies above Thavnair─

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001410_ESTINIEN
144.description: No more enemies to trouble us here...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001440_ESTINIEN
147.description: Chaos and panic sweep Radz-at-Han, and many more have succumbed to the transformations.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001450_ESTINIEN
148.description: Amidst the fray, Ahewann fell...protecting a grief-stricken father.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001470_ESTINIEN
150.description: My friends fight alongside your Radiant Host to secure the capital.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001480_ESTINIEN
151.description: Beasts have been sighted in Palaka's Stand as well. We have divided our forces in hopes of quelling the threat there.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001490_ESTINIEN
152.description: Of small solace is that we now know what triggers the transformation. As my companions tell it...

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001500_VRITRA
153.description: So it is the very fear and despair in their hearts which inflict this abhorrent punishment upon them...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001510_VRITRA
154.description: ...A nightmare from which my children will never awake. O capricious and cruel fate─they are undeserving of such condemnation...

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001520_ESTINIEN
155.description: Will you wallow in sorrow or rise to the occasion?

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001530_ESTINIEN
156.description: Radz-at-Han is leaderless. Before he passed, Ahewann sought to reveal the truth to his people. Honor his wishes.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001540_VRITRA
157.description: To what end? To breed a new conflict between dragon and man?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001550_VRITRA
158.description: These claws could reduce thee to shreds with a touch. These jaws, crush thy bones to dust.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001560_VRITRA
159.description: Only through my proxy could I walk with my children. Without him, I am a bringer of fear─no different from the beasts which beleaguer them.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001580_ESTINIEN
161.description: Only in death were Hraesvelgr and Shiva united. Indeed, whenever man and dragon have come together, death has ever been the inevitable result.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001590_ESTINIEN
162.description: 'Twas our fear of your kind that sparked a nigh-endless war.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001600_ESTINIEN
163.description: Fear and hate of which Nidhogg drank deep as he laid waste to my homeland.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001610_ESTINIEN
164.description: And in turn I took my revenge on his brood. Blood for blood; pain for pain. I thought nothing of theirs─only of mine.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001620_ESTINIEN
165.description: And yet...were the chasm between us too vast and too deep, Hraesvelgr would not have borne Ysayle to battle and our rescue.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001630_ESTINIEN
166.description: He would have never entrusted a mortal champion with one of his eyes, and the Dragonsong War would still rage on.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001640_ESTINIEN
167.description: And I would still wage a never-ending war of violence and vengeance, the future of our star be damned.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001650_ESTINIEN
168.description: I cannot speak for Ahewann's greater goals. Yet I know that he served you─served your people─long and true.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001660_ESTINIEN
169.description: In this time of unprecedented crisis, he turned to you. You could do worse than to place your trust in him.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001670_ESTINIEN
170.description: It will not be easy, but the future of Radz-at-Han hangs in the balance.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001700_ESTINIEN
173.description: The hour is come, Vrtra. It's all or nothing!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001710_ALPHINAUD
174.description: Courage, friend. The pain will pass.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001740_ALISAIE
177.description: We've dealt with all the blasphemies...and made certain no villagers are still in hiding.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001750_ALPHINAUD
178.description: Good work. We've otherwise tended to the wounded as best we can.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001770_PALAKASWOMANA
180.description: Help is on the way, surely. We may have to abandon our homes now, but we will return. Someday.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001780_PALAKASMAN
181.description: But where can we go? Is anywhere even safe?

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001800_PALAKASWOMANB
183.description: Well, I can. Nowhere's safe! Run all you like, but there's no escaping these things!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001810_PALAKASWOMANB
184.description: And even if I could...it's too late for my family!

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001830_ALISAIE
186.description: This isn't good. The more they dwell on the tragedy, the more likely we are to lose them, too...

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001840_MATSYA
187.description: My friends! This...this is a place of worship!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001850_MATSYA
188.description: Should your heart quake with sadness, cast your mind to the heavens and remember.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001860_MATSYA
189.description: Remember the teachings of the old gods. Did they not implore us to stand fast when waves of sorrow break against our shores?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001870_PALAKASWOMANA
190.description: Know this, my children. There is more ugliness than beauty in this world.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001880_PALAKASWOMANA
191.description: To live is to suffer. To drink of calamity and drown in anguish. To toil and be tested, always and ever.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001890_PALAKASOLDMAN
192.description: 'Tis a perilous path you walk. Death lurks in the dark, and is the sole promise that awaits at journey's end.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001900_PALAKASOLDMAN
193.description: You will tremble with terror. You will weep tears of anger and despair...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001910_PALAKASMAN
194.description: ...But do not avert your eyes. See your life for what it is.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001920_PALAKASMAN
195.description: Then will you see how the hardships make you strong.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001930_PALAKASWOMANB
196.description: Every doubt reforged as scales for your armor.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001940_PALAKASWOMANB
197.description: Every agony to temper your blade...

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001950_PALAKASOLDMAN
198.description: Thank you, lad. We'd almost forgotten who we are.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001960_PALAKASOLDMAN
199.description: My undying gratitude to you as well, my friends.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001970_PALAKASOLDMAN
200.description: You were searching for Mehvan, no? We must return home. I pray you help the boy find his friend.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001980_ALPHINAUD
201.description: Gladly. We dispatched what beasts we could, but the roads are still dangerous. Stay together, and go in safety.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_001990_ALISAIE
202.description: That was very impressive, what you did back there. Those words seemed to resonate with your people.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002000_MATSYA
203.description: They should. They were the first spoken unto our ancestors by the divinity of legend.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002010_MATSYA
204.description: I'm easily upset, and fish are wont to flee a temperamental hand. So I recite the teachings, over and over, to calm myself.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002020_ALISAIE
205.description: They're lovely and inspiring to hear. Though I imagine they were born of great misfortune.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002030_MATSYA
206.description: They are born of life. There's as much bad as good in it─more, many would attest. All the more reason to appreciate the good when you can.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002050_HYDAELYN
208.description: (-Hydaelyn-)In darkness seek joy. Surrender not to sadness, and see beyond despair. Walk free, and bear the light for others to follow.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002060_ALISAIE
209.description: And with that, let us see if we can't find Mehvan.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002070_ALISAIE
210.description: Did you see!? That beast was chasing someone!

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002080_MATSYA
211.description: That's her... No, I'm...I'm sure of it! Mehvan!

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002140_ALPHINAUD
218.description: The child is alert, and I see no wounds. And yet, she grows weaker...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002150_ALPHINAUD
219.description: My spells can do no more. What she needs is a change of clothes and a warm bed. We must hurry back!

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002180_ALPHINAUD
222.description: Godsdammit, it appears we've made enough noise to be heard for malms around. More will be upon us ere long.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002190_ALPHINAUD
223.description: We make our stand here. Matsya, can you take her back to the village?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002200_MATSYA
224.description: Th-The child? All...all by myself!? You can't be serious!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002210_ALISAIE
225.description: The beasts will follow you home unless we stop them here─and so we shall.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002220_ALISAIE
226.description: Be strong, Matsya! Her life is in your hands!

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002240_ALISAIE
228.description: I know you can! We'll keep them busy, Matsya. Go─quickly!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002280_MATSYA
232.description: Don't be afraid. Don't be afraid...

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002290_MATSYA
233.description: To live is to suffer. To drink of calamity...

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002300_MATSYA
234.description: 'Tis a perilous path... Death...lurks in the dark...

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002320_MATSYA
236.description: N-No! I'm not afraid! I'm not afraid!

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002340_MATSYA
238.description: Do not avert your eyes. See...see your life for what it is...

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002350_MATSYA
239.description: See how the hardships make you strong. Every doubt reforged...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002400_VRITRA
244.description: ...Nay. But one who would deliver thee just the same.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002410_MATSYA
245.description: Please... You must save the child!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002420_MATSYA
246.description: She is all that remains of Mehvan and Qerasaf. Please!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002430_ESTINIEN
247.description: Well, well. Seems the babe's taken a liking to you.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002440_VRITRA
248.description: Thou art strong, little one. Let us convey thee to thy home.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002460_ESTINIEN
250.description: I spied our friends as we flew in...they appeared to be holding their own against the horde.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002470_ALISAIE
251.description: Right. That's the last of them. We should hurry and find Matsya...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
253.description: I have a feeling he'll be fine.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
254.description: He had help. From on high.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002480_ALISAIE
255.description: Really? How can you be so sure?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002500_ESTINIEN
257.description: A fine battle it must have been. Shame I missed it.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002510_ALPHINAUD
258.description: Estinien! It was you who came to Matsya's aid?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002520_ESTINIEN
259.description: I was only along for the ride─Vrtra was the one who saw the boy was in need. The two are headed back to the village.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002530_ALPHINAUD
260.description: Where the wyrm will honor Ahewann's wishes and finally reveal himself to his people...

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002540_ESTINIEN
261.description: Perhaps so. Will you go and join them?

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002550_ALISAIE
262.description: There's something I need to do first.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002560_ALISAIE
263.description: Mehvan gave her life so that her child might live. She deserves better than to be left to drift alone.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002570_ALISAIE
264.description: She deserves to be laid to rest beside her husband, at least. Will you help me?

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002590_VARSHAHN
266.description: People of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. It warms my heart to see so many brave, resilient souls before me.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002600_VARSHAHN
267.description: Today, I would share with you a great revelation. But before I do, I must make a humble request...

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002610_VARSHAHN
268.description: Do not be alarmed, nor avert your eyes. See the one I unveil for who he is, and know that he means you no harm.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002620_HANNISHMANB
269.description: Very well. I daresay it can't be worse than the horrors we've already seen.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002660_VRITRA
273.description: People of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. I am Vrtra, and for years uncounted hath this isle served as mine abode.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002670_VRITRA
274.description: 'Tis as the satrap's ally I am known. Today, I would reveal the truth unto you.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002680_GRAHATIA
275.description: Let us hope they accept him.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002690_HANNISHMANB
276.description: If I am hearing this right, you were the satrap all along!?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002700_HANNISHBOYB
277.description: Varshahn─ I mean, Master Vrtra... D-Does your divine eye really see all?

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002710_VRITRA
278.description: ...Nay, child. While mine eye hath borne witness to the whole of our nation's history, to its future I am blind as thee.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002720_VRITRA
279.description: Countrymen. Calamity the likes of which we have never known is come to Thavnair. Our home.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002730_VRITRA
280.description: Friends and loved ones have been taken from us. I, too, have lost my closest confidant.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002740_VRITRA
281.description: Ahewann loved this land, and served it with dignity till his dying breath. A nobler satrap there will never be.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002750_VRITRA
282.description: For so long, I lacked the courage to face you. I will not easily earn your trust─this I know.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002760_VRITRA
283.description: And yet, I cannot sit idly by and abandon Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han to her fate.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002770_VRITRA
284.description: A font of boundless vibrancy, this jewel of the ocean. Since time immemorial hath she glittered with every color imaginable.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002780_VRITRA
285.description: To this dragon slumbering in his dark lair, 'twas a mesmerizing sight─and one that brought no end of joy to my heart.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002790_VRITRA
286.description: This calamity hath stolen too much from you already. Yet so long as you live, the light of Radz-at-Han will never be extinguished.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002800_VRITRA
287.description: I pray you let me watch over it...over you.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002810_VRITRA
288.description: And lend me your strength, that we might face this trial and those to come as one.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002820_HANNISHOLDWOMANB
289.description: I do not know you, dragon. But I thank you for speaking the truth to us.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002830_HANNISHOLDWOMANB
290.description: As divinities both Manusya and Mrga once joined together, so too do I believe that, hand in hand, we can overcome this ordeal, and welcome an era of peace.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002840_ALPHINAUD
291.description: ...A sight that would have surely brought a smile to Ysayle's face.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002860_FOURCHENAULT
293.description: Excuse me, but I must speak with the satrap at once.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002880_FOURCHENAULT
295.description: You have suffered dearly of late. Yet you must endeavor to look beyond these losses to the future you yet have.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002890_FOURCHENAULT
296.description: On behalf of the Forum of Sharlayan, I come with a proposal by which you, the people of Radz-at-Han, might be saved.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002900_FOURCHENAULT
297.description: I say again, I must speak with your satrap. I beseech you─take me to him with all possible haste.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002910_VRITRA
298.description: I am satrap here. Speak thy proposal. All present shall hear and judge.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002920_FOURCHENAULT
299.description: If I have given offense, then I apologize. First, allow me to share with you what knowledge we have of the phenomenon responsible for your woes: the Final Days.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002930_FOURCHENAULT
300.description: 'Tis an affliction of stagnancy and rot sown into the currents of the star. Though the first prominent manifestation was here in Thavnair, it will invariably spread to every corner of the world.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002940_FOURCHENAULT
301.description: The Forum was forewarned of this apocalypse several centuries ago.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002950_FOURCHENAULT
302.description: Thenceforth, my predecessors sought to prepare for the end times in the only conceivable fashion: by securing a means of escape.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002960_HANNISHMANB
303.description: Escape the star? What madness is this!?

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002980_FOURCHENAULT
305.description: With the coming of the Seventh Umbral Calamity, the true nature of the red moon Dalamud was revealed─that it was an artificial construct of ancient Allag.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_002990_FOURCHENAULT
306.description: But what of the silver moon?

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003000_FOURCHENAULT
307.description: This celestial satellite is yet another technological marvel fashioned and maintained by ancient allies. A ship that will sail the heavens and deliver our people from destruction.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003010_FOURCHENAULT
308.description: And by our people, I speak not only of Sharlayan. We mean to save every man, woman, and child it is within our power to save.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003020_FOURCHENAULT
309.description: Including you, our dear friends of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. Recent events necessitate adjustments be made, and quickly, but we can and will escort you safely to the moon.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003030_VRITRA
310.description: Long has thy Forum been allies to Thavnair. I trust thou dost not extend this offer lightly.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003040_VRITRA
311.description: Yet I wonder...is this truly the way? Is there a future to be built for us beyond this star our father deemed the last bastion of hope?

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003050_FOURCHENAULT
312.description: It is for that very reason I come before you and your people. To answer any and all of your questions. To offer my assurances and allay your fears.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003060_FOURCHENAULT
313.description: ...Though if you wish the best for your people, I advise you to render your decision swiftly.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003070_VRITRA
314.description: Show our friends to Meghaduta. They are to be received as honored guests.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003080_VRITRA
315.description: Worry not. Whatever decision is reached, your paths shall be yours to decide.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003090_VRITRA
316.description: Until then, heed the warning of these brave heroes─guard your hearts against fear and despair, for it is within such fertile soil that the seeds of blasphemy find purchase.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003100_VRITRA
317.description: Remain calm and attend to your daily tasks. I shall return anon.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003110_HANNISHBOYB
318.description: We'll do as you say, Master Vrtra. We believe in you!

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003120_NIDHANA
319.description: Oh, you're still here! What a relief!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003130_ALISAIE
320.description: Nidhana? What's the matter? Has something happened at Palaka's Stand?

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003140_NIDHANA
321.description: Oh, no! Not that I know of. I'd just hoped to hear your thoughts on a theory of mine.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003150_NIDHANA
322.description: All who undergo the transformation are drained of their aether, yes? What is it, then, that gives these beasts the strength to carry on as they do?

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003160_NIDHANA
323.description: Logically, they must be drawing upon an alternate form of vital energy. That put me in mind of our earlier conversation, when I tried to explain the essence which many confuse with aether.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003170_YSHTOLA
324.description: Akasa... Yes, I remember. The unseen gift bestowed from on high...

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003180_YSHTOLA
325.description: An energy influenced solely by emotion!

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003190_NIDHANA
326.description: Yes, yes. In this instance, negative ones set akasa into motion, thereby infusing the beasts with vitality. I posit this is the mechanism by which the beasts are born and sustained.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003200_NIDHANA
327.description: Ah─do you still have that flower?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003210_NIDHANA
328.description: If we accept that it once shone bright by drawing upon akasa influenced by the thoughts of those nearby...

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003220_NIDHANA
329.description: Then fear, terror, despair─negative emotions so powerful as to suffocate it─permeated the air in this place.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003230_NIDHANA
330.description: You must be very careful. The forces which drive the Final Days may be beyond our ability to perceive.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003240_NIDHANA
331.description: Sorry...I didn't mean to scare you like that. At any rate, I will continue my research into akasa.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003250_NIDHANA
332.description: Do temper your expectations, however. There are sadly few detailed studies upon which I may draw.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003260_YSHTOLA
333.description: Formulating a new theory, as you have, is itself no small feat. I wish you well in your endeavors, and pray you take care.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003270_NIDHANA
334.description: Thank you. You stay safe as well, yes? Till next we meet─and we will meet again!

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003280_YSHTOLA
335.description: So blasphemies now plague all the realm...

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003290_ALPHINAUD
336.description: It will only get worse, if what Father said is true. As it did in Amaurot...

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003300_THANCRED
337.description: If that's our model, then shouldn't we expect the effects to grow more severe as it feeds off its own spread?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003310_THANCRED
338.description: As if people transforming into those monstrosities wasn't bad enough, if the flora and fauna─if the land itself turned against us...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003340_MIHLEEL
341.description: May you find comfort in these dark times.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003350_ALISAIE
342.description: Where do we go from here?

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003360_ALISAIE
343.description: If there's one thing we've learned, fighting blindly and simply reacting to what comes will accomplish nothing.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003370_ALISAIE
344.description: We must find a solution that addresses the fundamental cause. Before our strength is exhausted. Before this crisis spirals out of control!

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003390_YSHTOLA
346.description: If there is an answer, Hydaelyn Herself will have it. 'Twas She who bound Zodiark and forestalled the Final Days.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003400_YSHTOLA
347.description: Alas, we have heard naught from Her since the Tower of Babil. Whether She cannot or will not speak, I can only speculate...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003410_YSHTOLA
348.description: Even the flower She gave us is no more...

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003420_WATCHEROFMOON
349.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In our time, we called it “Elpis”... You would do well to remember the name.<hex:0248020103>

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003430_YSHTOLA
350.description: So advised the watcher...but what could be the significance of that name? It is entirely unfamiliar to me.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003440_ALPHINAUD
351.description: To me as well. It meant something to the ancients, though. “In <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> time...”

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003450_YSHTOLA
352.description: Most surely. Yet I do not recall a single mention of it in the records of Anyder.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003460_ALISAIE
353.description: Another dead end, and quite literally. It's not as if there are any ancients living we could go and ask...

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003470_GRAHATIA
354.description: Not alive as such...but not quite dead...

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003490_GRAHATIA
356.description: I sealed him in the white auracite of the Crystal Tower, back on the First.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003500_GRAHATIA
357.description: Contained within that reservoir of aether that maintains it─aether that is returned little by little to the sea...naught may remain of his soul.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003510_GRAHATIA
358.description: However, if part of it lingers...we might be able to speak with him there.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003520_GRAHATIA
359.description: I─no, we can no longer make that journey. But you, my friend, still can.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
362.description: It would be an opportunity to look in on the others as well.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
363.description: If there is truly no other way...

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003530_GRAHATIA
364.description: Yes, we can but act and hope for the best!

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003540_GRAHATIA
365.description: Thank you, my friend. That would mean much to me.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003550_GRAHATIA
366.description: I understand your trepidation, but there is merit in making the journey regardless. You could see with your own eyes whether the First, too, faces its Final Days.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003560_THANCRED
367.description: If nothing else, should we learn the First is safe, we'll have that much more reason to keep fighting the good fight.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003570_THANCRED
368.description: That said...the odds are not in our favor, to say the least.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003580_THANCRED
369.description: Which is why we're fortunate to have Urianger up there on the moon, working hard to make all the necessary preparations for our departure, should it come to it.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003590_ALISAIE
370.description: ...And why we have nothing to lose by staying the course till the last instant!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003600_YSHTOLA
371.description: Indeed. To the last, let us all do what we can.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003610_YSHTOLA
372.description: I will consult with Master Matoya and see if she knows of a way to reach Hydaelyn from the aetherial sea.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003620_ALPHINAUD
373.description: And I will visit the nations' leaders and attempt to ascertain how far the Final Days have progressed elsewhere.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003630_ESTINIEN
374.description: Keep me abreast of your findings. I can seek out and slay the worst of the immediate threats, if only to slow the spread.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003640_ALPHINAUD
375.description: Unease, terror, despair... Try as we might to suppress them, these emotions will return to harry us time and time again.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003650_ALPHINAUD
376.description: But when they do, remember this...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003660_ALPHINAUD
377.description: Your friends and loved ones are out there, somewhere, sharing in your struggle. You are not alone.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003670_EMETSELCH
378.description: So ends the brief respite before the next revelation.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003680_EMETSELCH
379.description: Yes, so much left for you to see...

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06003_003690_EMETSELCH
380.description: Where beginning ends, and end begins...
